gloss: actually, in fact, to tell the truth

definitions.gloss: actually, in fact, to tell the truth
definitions.explanation: Used to introduce what is really true, often contrasting with appearances or expectations.

examples.japanese: {本当|ほんとう}は⟦{何|なに}→何：00498_nani⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{食|た}べたい→食べる：00396_taberu⟧？
examples.english: What do you really want to eat?

examples.japanese: {本当|ほんとう}は⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{犯人|はんにん}→犯人：03572_hannin⟧⟦だった→だ：09496_da⟧。
{本当|ほんとう}は⟦{行|い}きたくなかった→行く：00119_iku⟧⟦けど→けど：09477_kedo⟧、⟦{誘|さそ}われた→誘う：01947_sasou⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: To tell the truth, I didn't want to go, but I went because I was invited.

examples.japanese: {本当|ほんとう}は⟦{転職|てんしょく}→転職：04557_tenshoku⟧⟦したい→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}っている→思う：00492_omou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦なかなか→なかなか：01547_nakanaka⟧⟦{言|い}い{出|だ}せない→言い出す：04593_iidasu⟧。
examples.english: I actually want to change jobs, but I can't bring myself to say it.

examples.japanese: {本当|ほんとう}は⟦{甘|あま}い→甘い：00617_amai⟧⟦もの→物：02259_mono⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大好|だいす}き→大好き：02911_daisuki⟧⟦なのに→のに：10529_noni⟧、⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{我慢|がまん}→我慢：00057_gaman⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{誰|だれ}→誰：00534_dare⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{言|い}っていない→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: I haven't told anyone that I actually love sweets but am holding back for the sake of my health.

notes:
{本当|ほんとう}は is used to express what is actually true, often revealing something hidden or contrasting with what was previously said or believed.

POSITION IN SENTENCE:
- Usually at the beginning of a clause or sentence
- Sets up a contrast with apparent reality

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {本当|ほんとう}は〜たい/たくない (really want to/don't want to)
- {本当|ほんとう}は〜だ (actually is ~)
- {本当|ほんとう}は〜けど (actually ~, but...)

USAGE:
- Often used to confess true feelings
- Can introduce surprising or contrasting information
- More emphasis than ⟦ただ→ただ：01613_tada⟧/⟦{実際|じっさい}→実際：02502_jissai⟧

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{実|じつ}は→実は：02524_jitsuha⟧: actually (similar, slightly more formal)
- ⟦{実際|じっさい}→実際：02502_jissai⟧は: in reality (more objective)
- ⟦{正直|しょうじき}→正直：01562_shoujiki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{言|い}うと→言う：00515_iu⟧: to be honest
